resources.string: Stored on this device and available offline. Local validation is neither a contractual signature nor acceptance by FORLOG.
Find your pile and log measurements, check quantities, then record their physical stock entry.
No receipt for this worksite. Historical stock declarations remain in the timber journal.
Each line creates one opening stock entry for its timber object. Source measurements are frozen with this version. Check quantities, units and conventions before confirming.
Return to the document after refusal
The draft is saved without changing stock. You can resume it before reviewing it.
Choose a saved measurement for each pile or log linked to this worksite. Each timber object can appear only once.
No other eligible timber. Link a pile or log with a saved measurement and no existing opening stock to this worksite.
A geometric volume cannot be calculated from this measurement.
This measurement helps the review. It establishes neither a payable quantity nor a conversion to another unit.
Reason for the retained quantity or difference
Remove this timber from the draft
Reference photos already saved in the timber journal (up to 6).
Review: the quantities below will become local opening stock entries. This receipt has not yet created any movement.
Movements and checks for this timber

The cancelled receipt and timber remain stored. Cancellation is final: receiving this same timber again is not yet supported. No movement may depend on this receipt. This does not cancel any invoice, service or sale.
Recorded on %1$s · local space, no identified account
Cancellation refused: movements or corrections depend on this receipt. Check the journal for the timber concerned. No movement was deleted.
The result needs checking. Retry the same operation; no additional entry will be created if it was already recorded.
Check the date, source measurement, positive quantity, unit and convention. Explain differences from the source measurement. Timber with existing opening stock cannot be received again.
Piles, logs and measurements recorded in the field.
Prepare, check and record a physical stock entry.
Choose linked timber for removals, observations and photos. The worksite journal contains access details, instructions and activities.
Verifiable GeoSylva dossier: JSON, CSV tables and photo references.
The worksite will become active again. Its history and links will be retained.
No linked timber. Save a depot and its piles or logs, then link them to this worksite.
The archive includes the worksite, its linked parcels, timber, observations, receipt versions and movements. Balances are read back and verified before saving.
Photo references and hashes are included, not image files. This remains a GeoSylva export; nothing is sent to FORLOG or GSIE.
Choose where to save the ZIP
Verified archive · %1$d timber object(s) · %2$d receipt(s) and version(s) · %3$d event(s)
GeoSylva dossier saved to the selected location.
The archive could not be verified or saved. No synchronisation is confirmed; you can retry.
The archive represents the dossier when it was prepared. Prepare it again after changing the worksite.
The export was interrupted, but the file provider refused cleanup. Delete the ZIP file at the location you selected; it may contain partial data.
